constraints.name: Concentration vs hard cap (market value)
constraints.reason: Market-value weight is known, but no hard cap has been supplied by the portfolio owner. Required and unset: hard_cap_pct, core_target_pct, policy_version, effective_date. The system does not invent position limits.

constraints.name: Deviation from core target (market value)
constraints.reason: No core target supplied by the portfolio owner. Required and unset: {miss}.

constraints.name: Concentration (cost basis)
constraints.reason: Cost-basis weight is reported as a fact only. It is NOT a concentration measure: concentration risk is a function of current market value.

constraints.name: Liquidity (days to liquidate)
constraints.reason: Average daily volume is not wired into this slice.

constraints.name: Tax impact of a sale
constraints.reason: Tax lots and acquisition dates are unavailable; the broker export records average cost only. Realised gain or loss on a partial sale cannot be computed.

evidence.explanation: Unconditional distribution of AMZN's own completed 1w forward returns, using only sessions at or before 2026-08-07.
evidence.limitations: Point-in-time: yes (no window extends past as_of). Survivorship: this symbol survived the whole sample, so the distribution is conditioned on survival. Universe selection: this symbol is in the sample because it is a current holding. Overlapping windows: yes, so n overstates independent observations. DESCRIPTIVE ONLY - this is history, not a forecast.
